recipe.variant: lihaoyun6 ComfyUI-FlashVSR_Ultra_Fast (GPL-3.0, the original wrapper; RTX 50 support via Sparse_Sage since 2025-10-22), v1.1 weights, 4x, mode tiny, bf16, tiled VAE + tiled DiT (the node defaults)
recipe.from_template: No Comfy-Org local template. Graph as the pack README documents (dossier 4a): FlashVSRInitPipe -> FlashVSRNodeAdv with the nodes.py defaults; scale raised from the node default 2 to 4 per the README ('4 is always better, unless you are low on VRAM then use 2').
recipe.min_comfyui_note: NOT FOUND (neither pack states a ComfyUI minimum); the native spine nodes exist in v0.35.0
recipe.confidence_note: pack README + nodes.py (official for the pack); the Lackluster fork documents the same node ids and parameters

mode.note: tiny | tiny-long ('significantly reduce VRAM used with long video input') | full (Wan VAE decode, higher quality)

alt_vae.note: none, or any file in models/vae: 'Replaces the built-in VAE, only available in full mode'

force_offload.note: offload all weights to CPU after the run

tiled_dit.note: 'Significantly reduces VRAM usage at the cost of speed'

video.note: the clip to upscale; frames go to the FlashVSR node, fps and audio pass from GetVideoComponents to CreateVideo. FlashVSR is a streaming model: feed a clip (>= 21 frames), not a still.

recipe.files_note: the four files of the JunhaoZhuang/FlashVSR-v1.1 HF repo, downloaded as-is into ComfyUI/models/FlashVSR/ (the node's `model` option names the version folder); the exact subfolder layout the pack expects: NOT FOUND, follow the pack README. The fixed prompt embedding (posi_prompt.pth) ships inside the node repo.
recipe.packs_note: mutually exclusive with LacklusterOpsec/ComfyUI-Lackluster-FlashVSR (same node class ids). Turing or older: pip install -U "triton<3.3.0" (Windows: "triton-windows<3.3.0").
recipe.defaults_note: tiny mode + tiled VAE/DiT + bf16 are the node defaults; README VRAM advice: 2x only when low on VRAM, tiny-long for long clips, unload_dit to cut the decode peak.

vram_evidence.usage: NOT FOUND (no VRAM table in this pack's README); official paper: ~17 FPS at 768x1408 on one A100 with the reference implementation

verify: Native spine (LoadVideo -> GetVideoComponents -> CreateVideo -> SaveVideo) checked against the v0.35.0 registry on 2026-10-01. The FlashVSR classes are a custom pack: the offline validator reports them as 'not in v0.35.0' and, as a consequence, CreateVideo.images as 'has no output 0' (it cannot type the pack node's output). Expected for a pack recipe; resolves once the pack is installed and the live /object_info is read (Phase 2).

Input names, options and defaults are transcribed from the dossier's reading of the pack's nodes.py / README (2026-10-01), not from a registry: confirm the exact required key set against the live /object_info after install (an API prompt must carry every required widget).
